title: Epigenetic control of telomeric RNA maintains heterochromatin in telomerase-driven cancers
model: HT1080 HTelo-/HTelo+ (GFP-hTERT) and five other xenograft models; in vivo validation pool of 196 guides on 98 SDL candidates, no non-targeting guides
contrast: HTelo+ vs HTelo- Cas9 tumors (2 vs 2); Cas9 vs 'Wild Type' per model as secondary
paper_method: t-test with permutation p-values (HTelo); MAGeCK RRA per model
paper_calls: Top SDL hits named: FTSJ3, MED14, RRM2, GNB1L, PRMT1 (HTelo); FTSJ3, MED14, PRMT1, GNB1L, PRPF19, LMNB1 across models
barcs_calls: 8 genes at FDR 0.10 (all depleted); no control calibration possible
named_hits: 3/5 at FDR 0.10 (MED14, GNB1L, RRM2); FTSJ3 rank 9 of 91, FDR 0.12
verdict: BARCS ranks four of the five named HTelo hits in its top 9 and calls MED14, GNB1L and RRM2, but the calls rest on 2 clonal tumors per arm with single-guide jackpots, the line-by-Cas9 interaction calls nothing, and without controls or a described Wild Type arm the SDL claim cannot be confirmed from these counts.
